description:
The IT Workplace Engineer manages PwC endpoints in line with global endpoint management policies. This role is responsible for endpoint-related services and support for all IT end-users across multiple platforms, ensuring a reliable, compliant, and efficient endpoint environment.


Job Duties:

  • Operate, maintain, and improve the IT endpoint fleet 
  • Provide second-level support to end-users
  • Train first-level support teams and create knowledge base articles
  • Develop solutions that optimize endpoint management and support compliance
  • Perform hygiene tasks to maintain a lean and well-managed endpoint environment

Skills:

  • Experience managing MDM solutions
  • Knowledge of Microsoft 365 Fundamentals (MS-900) and Microsoft Entra Directory / Azure Active Directory
  • Familiarity with Active Directory and Group Policy Objects
  • Proficiency in PowerShell
  • Team- and customer-oriented mindset, with the ability to work independently
  • Familiarity with ITIL change management best practices is an advantage

Qualifications:

  • Education:
  • A relevant degree, such as a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or Information Technology, is an advantage
  • Experience:
  • Two years of experience in a related endpoint management role within a corporate environment
  • Language:
  • Fluent written and spoken English
